title: PaymentProcessed
description: Emitted when an ACH/EFT payment completes successfully. Replaces PaymentService.processAchPayment() which synchronously updated account balance and loan status.

eventId.description: Unique identifier for this event instance.

occurredAt.description: When the payment finished processing (ISO 8601, UTC).

version.description: Schema version of the event contract.

loanId.description: Identifier of the loan the payment applies to.

processedDate.description: When the payment was processed (ISO 8601, UTC).

status.description: Final processing status, e.g. COMPLETED, FAILED, RETURNED.

principalApplied.description: Amount of principal applied to the loan, in dollars.

newBalance.description: Resulting loan balance after the payment, in dollars.
